inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL function catalog documents INSTR as a one-based search for the first occurrence of one string inside another, with NULL propagation when an argument is absent.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored message-offset report. Fixed messages locate an incident token, a repeated token, an empty needle, a missing token, a multibyte token, and SQL NULL; the source catalog row and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Message 401 locates INC-482, 402 finds the first repeated token, 403 exercises an empty needle, 404 has no match, 405 locates a Greek token by character position, and 406 has NULL text.
determinism_notes: Message IDs and text are fixed, and output is ordered by the primary key with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE message_offsets (message_id INT PRIMARY KEY, message_text VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL, needle VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL)

INSERT INTO message_offsets VALUES (401, 'Escalated INC-482 to the database team', 'INC-482'), (402, 'retry retry accepted', 'retry'), (403, 'empty needle remains defined', ''), (404, 'ordinary maintenance window', 'INC-999'), (405, 'prefix Ωmega marker', 'Ωmega'), (406, NULL, 'missing')

steps.sql: SELECT message_id, needle, INSTR(message_text, needle) AS first_offset, CASE WHEN message_text IS NULL THEN 'missing-text' WHEN needle = '' THEN 'empty-needle' WHEN INSTR(message_text, needle) = 0 THEN 'not-found' ELSE 'found' END AS offset_class FROM message_offsets ORDER BY message_id

checks.sql: SELECT message_id, message_text, needle FROM message_offsets ORDER BY message_id
